svg.aria-label: Left: the corpus of 35,505 papers splits level by level until every leaf holds 10 to 50 papers. Research-question granularity is set by size: the highest node whose subtree holds at most 150 papers is a topic, itself a broader research question, and each leaf is a finer one. Right: one topic of 120 papers on a timeline from September 2025 to January 2026, cut into 31-day windows; each window is a cohort whose cutoff t is its start. Each of the topic's three leaves alone is sparse, about 6 to 9 papers per window, while the topic as a whole gives about 24.
